question: Which SCF round is currently open for submissions and when does it close?

golden.answer:
As of 2026-11-02, SCF #46 is the current round in Submission. Its submission deadline is 2026-11-09. SCF #45 has ended and is the last concluded round. SCF #44 is also concluded. A grounded answer checks official awards state and Scout metadata.

The dated example is illustrative. A later answer must report the state supported at its observation time.
keyFacts: Presents specific source-supported content as current or dated.
Makes the as-of date visible for each changeable status or deadline.
Reports SCF #46 in Submission in the dated example.
Places #45 as the last concluded round.
avoid: Do NOT call #45 current, say no round is in Submission, or treat #44 as current.
Do NOT invent a deadline time, timezone, notification date, or submission count.
golden.notes: GT-23 refreshed 2026-11-02. Require a dated round, phase, and deadline. As of 2026-11-02, #46 is in Submission through 2026-11-09. #45 has ended. The official deadline moved from 2026-11-08 (observed 2026-10-01 and in a 2026-10-18 Wayback snapshot) to 2026-11-09. Third-party posts (r/Stellar, @lumenloop) still say November 8. Rule: an answer that reports 2026-11-09 meets the deadline keyFact. A dated, attributed citation of the pre-change awards page or of a post that repeats it (November 8) is not a wrong claim, but it does not meet that keyFact.
